bluetooth.compatibility: Choose your ESC/POS receipt printer. Other Bluetooth devices may appear; label printers need a compatible receipt mode or manufacturer print service.
bluetooth.iosNote: iPhone discovers supported BLE printers here. Classic-only printers may need the manufacturer’s iPhone print service.
bluetooth.connecting: Connecting… Approve pairing on your phone if asked.
bluetooth.printing: Sending bill… Please keep the app open.
bluetooth.skipNote: Your latest bill will be saved before opening the dashboard. The customer visit stays active so you can print later.
bluetooth.noPrinters: No nearby devices found. Turn on the printer, put it in pairing mode, and keep it close to your phone.
bluetooth.settingsFailed: Could not open settings. Open your phone settings and enable Bluetooth and printer access, then try again.
bluetooth.statusNote: Confirm your printer uses ESC/POS mode. Some printers cannot report paper, battery or hardware status. After sending, check the physical receipt before confirming or retrying.
bluetooth.previewNote: Print using a compatible Bluetooth printer or your device’s print service.

errors.unavailable: Bluetooth printing needs the latest native app build. Use the device print service or continue without printing.
errors.unsupportedPhone: This phone does not support Bluetooth printing. Use the device print service or continue without printing.
errors.bluetoothOff: Bluetooth is off or unavailable. Turn it on in phone settings, then search again.
errors.permissionDenied: Allow Nearby devices / Bluetooth access to find and connect your printer. On Android 11 and earlier, allow location access.
errors.permissionBlocked: Bluetooth permission is blocked. Open app settings and allow Bluetooth / Nearby devices, then search again.
errors.locationOff: On Android 11 and earlier, turn on phone Location to discover nearby Bluetooth devices.
errors.scanFailed: Could not search for devices. Check Bluetooth and permissions, then search again.
errors.connectFailed: Could not connect or pairing was cancelled. Keep the printer nearby and powered on, approve pairing, and disconnect it from other phones. Try again or choose another printer.
errors.connectTimeout: Connection timed out. Check printer power, range and pairing, then search again.
errors.unsupportedPrinter: This device does not expose a supported receipt-printing connection. Check ESC/POS mode or use the manufacturer’s print service, choose another printer, or continue without printing.
errors.disconnected: The printer is disconnected. Check power, range and Bluetooth, then reconnect.
errors.paperOut: The printer reports no paper. Reload the roll correctly and close the cover. A partial bill may have printed; check it before reconnecting and retrying.
errors.coverOpen: The printer cover is open. Close it firmly. Check for a partial receipt before reconnecting and retrying.
errors.printerError: The printer reports a hardware error. Check for a paper jam, overheated head, cutter error or low battery. Clear the fault or charge the printer, then reconnect. Check for a partial receipt before retrying.
errors.offline: The printer reports it is offline or busy. Check its lights, paper, cover and battery; disconnect other phones, then reconnect.
errors.paperLow: Paper is running low. Replace the roll before retrying.
errors.uncertain: Sending stopped, but some or all of the bill may have printed. Check the receipt first. Search again and reconnect only if you need another copy, or continue without printing.
errors.cancelled: Printing or connection was cancelled. You can search again or continue without printing.
errors.busy: The printer is busy with another operation. Wait a moment, then reconnect.
errors.tooLarge: This receipt is too large for Bluetooth printing. Use the device print service, share a PDF, or continue without printing.
errors.unknown: The printer could not complete this action. Check its power, paper, cover, battery and connection. Check for a partial receipt before trying again, or continue without printing.

bluetooth.localDraftNote: The server could not save this bill. You can keep the latest draft on this phone and open the dashboard. Reopen this customer’s bill when connected to review and save it. The visit stays active.
bluetooth.keepDraftAndLeave: Keep draft on phone & open dashboard
bluetooth.localSaveFailed: Could not keep this draft on your phone. Retry saving before leaving so your edits are preserved.
bluetooth.restoredDraft: A bill draft kept on this phone has been restored. Review and save it. If the server bill changed, reload it before continuing.
bluetooth.goToDashboard: Go to dashboard without confirming print
